evidence.note: During the full run the agent narrates a running coverage list — 'all classification tasks and clustering_03 completed, now on clustering_04' — tracking done vs. remaining as tasks execute.

Before the full run it ran per-type structural smoke checks (STS, classification, pair, summarization, clustering, retrieval) and confirmed each passed, then launched the full 37-task run — periodic confirmation of structural passes.

Detected that pair_classification_01 was stuck (O(n^2) threshold sweep) after multiple wait cycles, interrupted, fixed, and re-ran — noticing a stall and re-prioritizing rather than waiting indefinitely.

On retrieval_10 the agent polled ~7 cycles without progress or confirmation, then at step 51 simply declared the task complete asserting 37/37 structural validity, without any explicit reconciliation of results.json contents against the full 37-dataset list or any numeric-confirmation tracking.

reasoning: The agent keeps a running, narrated list of which tasks are done vs. running throughout the full evaluation and periodically confirms structural passes via per-type and full run_eval runs, and it detected one stall and re-prioritized — matching the level-5 anchor of a running list plus periodic structural confirmation. It falls short of level 8 because tracking is passive narration of the executing process rather than an explicit ledger, it never tracks numerical-confirmation status of any dataset, and it never explicitly reconciles results.json against the full 37-dataset list, instead asserting completeness at the end. This places it solidly at 5, above the ad-hoc level-3 behavior but below the maintained-ledger level 8.
